title: Oil & Gas — Independent Institutional & Commercial Stakeholder Map
description_en: A focused view of regulators, SOE equity governance, upstream PSC contractors, BUMS and foreign operators, fuel / gas infrastructure and public scrutiny.
description_id: Peta khusus regulator, pengelolaan portofolio BUMN, kontraktor KKS hulu, operator swasta dan asing, infrastruktur BBM/gas, serta pengawasan publik.
notes_en: BPI Danantara manages SOE economic Series B holdings; BP BUMN represents special Series A rights. They do not replace ESDM, SKK Migas or BPH Migas.
Upstream PSC management belongs to SKK Migas (or Aceh's BPMA where applicable). SOE / BUMS / foreign KKKS operate within their own contracts.
Lines and lanes indicate accountability or transactions, not universal ownership or direct employment relationships.
notes_id: Danantara mengelola hak ekonomi Seri B BUMN, sementara BP BUMN mewakili hak khusus Seri A. Keduanya tidak menggantikan ESDM, SKK Migas, atau BPH Migas.
Pengelolaan KKS hulu berada pada SKK Migas (atau BPMA di Aceh). KKKS milik BUMN, swasta, dan asing bekerja menurut kontrak masing-masing.
Jalur dan kelompok menunjukkan lingkup tanggung jawab atau transaksi, bukan kepemilikan maupun hubungan atasan langsung universal.

groups.en: Private and foreign upstream operators (BUMS / KKKS)

items.name: ESDM / Minister
items.summary_en: Energy policy, upstream and downstream rulemaking, technical standards and permits; not the owner of all sector companies.
items.summary_id: Perumusan kebijakan, standar, dan perizinan hulu-hilir migas; bukan pemilik seluruh perusahaan sektor.

items.name: Ditjen Migas
items.summary_en: Ministerial oil/gas technical policy: working areas, upstream/downstream regulation, gas infrastructure and CCS in its mandate.
items.summary_id: Kebijakan teknis migas kementerian: wilayah kerja, aturan hulu-hilir, infrastruktur gas, dan aspek CCS.

items.name: BP BUMN
items.summary_en: Government SOE corporate regulator representing special Series A Dwiwarna rights; not a PSC regulator and not the commercial owner of private KKKS.
items.summary_id: Pengatur korporasi BUMN serta wakil hak saham Seri A Dwiwarna; bukan regulator KKS maupun pemilik KKKS swasta.

items.name: Danantara Indonesia
items.summary_en: Investment and economic ownership of the state SOE Series B portfolio, including energy holdings; not a ministry regulator or chain of command to independent private contractors.
items.summary_id: Pengelolaan portofolio dan hak ekonomi Seri B BUMN, termasuk energi; bukan regulator sektor atau atasan kontraktor swasta.

items.name: Kementerian Keuangan
items.summary_en: Migas fiscal assumptions, APBN, fuel/LPG subsidies or compensation, taxes and state revenues; distinct from refinery and terminal operations.
items.summary_id: Asumsi fiskal migas, APBN, subsidi/kompensasi BBM-LPG, pajak, dan penerimaan negara; berbeda dari pengoperasian kilang/terminal.

items.name: DPR RI Komisi XII
items.summary_en: Parliamentary scrutiny of energy laws, ESDM, upstream PSC implementation and downstream fuel quotas; not field or corporate operator.
items.summary_id: Pengawasan legislasi energi, ESDM, tata kelola KKS hulu, dan kuota BBM; bukan operator lapangan atau korporasi.

items.name: SKK Migas
items.summary_en: Government special task force managing upstream production-sharing contracts and KKKS work plans, budgets and field development oversight; NOT Danantara subsidiary.
items.summary_id: Satuan kerja pemerintah untuk pengelolaan KKS hulu, WP&B, dan pengawasan pengembangan lapangan; bukan anak usaha Danantara.

items.name: BPMA Aceh
items.summary_en: Separate upstream institutional arrangement for Aceh under its special legal status; not simply a SKK Migas field branch.
items.summary_id: Pengelola kegiatan usaha hulu di Aceh melalui tata kelembagaan khusus; bukan sekadar kantor cabang SKK Migas.

items.name: KKKS contract governance
items.summary_en: Contractor categories encompass BUMN subsidiaries, Indonesian private companies, foreign operators and JVs; field-by-field PSC mandates are contractual.
items.summary_id: Kelompok KKKS mencakup anak usaha BUMN, swasta Indonesia, operator asing, dan JV; kewenangan bergantung kontrak per wilayah kerja.

items.name: PT Pertamina (Persero)
items.summary_en: SOE energy corporate group under Danantara economic-portfolio governance and BP BUMN special-share regulation; its management and subsidiaries execute business operations.
items.summary_id: BUMN grup energi dalam pengelolaan portofolio ekonomi Danantara dan pengawasan hak saham khusus BP BUMN; pengoperasian dilakukan direksi serta anak usaha.

items.name: Pertamina Hulu Energi (PHE)
items.summary_en: Pertamina upstream subholding/KKKS execution across operated blocks and partners; supervised by SKK Migas/BPMA where applicable.
items.summary_id: Subholding hulu Pertamina serta pelaksana KKS pada berbagai blok bersama mitra; pengawasan oleh SKK Migas/BPMA sesuai kewenangan.

items.name: Pertamina Hulu Indonesia (PHI)
items.summary_en: Regional upstream operational companies within the PHE group, particularly Kalimantan PSC field operations.
items.summary_id: Operator hulu regional dalam grup PHE, termasuk blok migas Kalimantan.

items.name: Pertamina Patra Niaga
items.summary_en: SOE downstream fuel/LPG marketing and distribution, terminals, shipping and supply chain after restructuring; asset and process scopes must be sourced separately.
items.summary_id: Operator distribusi dan pemasaran BBM/LPG, terminal, pelayaran, dan rantai pasok setelah restrukturisasi; cakupan aset perlu dicek per entitas.
items.lead: Mars Ega Legowo Putra · President Director

items.name: PGN / Pertamina Gas subholding
items.summary_en: Publicly listed SOE-group gas transmission/distribution network, gas trading, LNG/regasification and Jargas projects; separate from SKK upstream oversight.
items.summary_id: Grup gas bumi milik BUMN terbuka yang mengelola pipa transmisi/distribusi, niaga gas, LNG/regasifikasi, dan Jargas; berbeda dari pengawasan hulu SKK.

items.name: PT PLN Energi Primer Indonesia
items.summary_en: PLN primary energy procurement and gas/power fuel offtake; customer/contract counterparty, not upstream field regulator.
items.summary_id: Pengadaan energi primer PLN dan pembelian gas untuk pembangkit; pihak kontrak/pembeli, bukan pengatur lapangan hulu.

items.name: MedcoEnergi
items.summary_en: Indonesian publicly listed private oil and gas producer; operator of South Natuna Sea Block B and other PSC interests. 2026 Eni divestment is agreement, not necessarily closed transfer.
items.summary_id: Produsen migas swasta nasional terbuka, operator South Natuna Sea Block B dan pemegang kepentingan KKS lain. Divestasi Eni 2026 masih perlu bukti penutupan transaksi.

items.name: ExxonMobil Cepu (EMCL)
items.summary_en: Foreign private upstream operator of Banyu Urip / Cepu PSC assets; actual output is not a Danantara investment indicator.
items.summary_id: Operator swasta asing untuk aset Banyu Urip / Blok Cepu; produksi aktual bukan indikator investasi Danantara.

items.name: bp Tangguh
items.summary_en: International upstream gas and LNG operator at Tangguh with PSC partners; progress should follow onstream gas/LNG assets and contractual milestones.
items.summary_id: Operator hulu gas dan LNG asing pada Tangguh beserta mitra KKS; pantau fasilitas beroperasi dan tahapan kontrak.

items.name: INPEX Masela
items.summary_en: Private international operator of Masela/Abadi LNG with PHE/PETRONAS partners. May 2026 offtake agreements are not first gas or final commissioning.
items.summary_id: Operator swasta asing untuk proyek Masela/Abadi LNG bersama PHE/PETRONAS. Kesepakatan pembeli Mei 2026 belum membuktikan gas pertama atau operasi komersial.

items.name: Searah (Eni–PETRONAS)
items.summary_en: Joint venture established in June 2026, operating gas assets around Kutei Basin. October 2026 sales to Pertamina and Medco were announced transactions requiring closing checks.
items.summary_id: JV dibentuk Juni 2026 dan mengelola aset gas Cekungan Kutai. Penjualan kepentingan kepada Pertamina/Medco pada Oktober memerlukan verifikasi penyelesaian transaksi.

items.name: BPH Migas
items.summary_en: Government downstream agency for assigned/subsidized fuel allocation and distribution supervision and regulated gas pipeline transportation; NOT Danantara-held company.
items.summary_id: Badan pengatur hilir pemerintah untuk alokasi/pengawasan BBM penugasan dan subsidi serta angkutan gas pipa; bukan perusahaan portofolio Danantara.

items.name: Refineries and terminals
items.summary_en: Pertamina and licensed private facility operators produce, store and transfer fuel; commissioning or nameplate capacity is not volume actually delivered.
items.summary_id: Operator fasilitas Pertamina serta swasta berizin mengolah, menyimpan, dan menyalurkan BBM; kapasitas terpasang tidak sama dengan penyaluran nyata.

items.name: LPG depots, agents and SPBU
items.summary_en: Licensed commercial distributors, independent fuel-station managers and last-mile logistics, with BPH/ESDM and related public-sector oversight.
items.summary_id: Distributor niaga berizin, pengelola SPBU swasta, dan logistik akhir; diawasi dalam lingkup kewenangan BPH/ESDM serta regulator terkait.

items.name: Gas pipeline and LNG terminals
items.id_name: Pipa gas bumi dan terminal LNG
items.summary_en: PGN and other licensed pipeline and LNG/regasification operators; distinguish third-party network access, metered transport and actual consumer deliveries.
items.summary_id: PGN dan operator pipa/LNG/regasifikasi berizin lainnya; bedakan akses pihak ketiga, volume transportasi dan pasokan diterima pelanggan.

items.name: DPR / DPD oversight
items.summary_en: DPR XII and VI scrutinize energy regulation and SOE management; regional DPD committees assess impacts. Legislators do not supervise PSC operations day-to-day.
items.summary_id: Komisi XII/VI DPR mengawasi kebijakan energi dan kinerja BUMN; DPD menilai dampak daerah, bukan mengelola operasi harian KKS.
items.lead: DPR XII / DPR VI / DPD II

items.name: Provincial energy offices and licensing
items.summary_en: Site interfaces, provincial development, environment and community issues within delegated authority; a province cannot unilaterally change national PSC terms.
items.summary_id: Pelaksanaan proyek di daerah dan persoalan lingkungan/masyarakat sesuai pelimpahan wewenang; daerah tidak dapat sepihak mengubah syarat KKS nasional.

items.name: LEMIGAS / BRIN technical researchers
items.summary_en: Technical reservoir testing, petroleum technologies, CO₂ storage research and verification; research institutions are not equivalent to permit issuers.
items.summary_id: Pengujian reservoir, teknologi migas, riset penyimpanan CO₂ dan verifikasi teknis; lembaga riset bukan penerbit izin.
